rc3_relation_materialization.semantic_note: Zero rows means no relation is asserted by L1_PACKET_01; it does not mean external absence.

rules.rule: For RC3 materialization, taxon_concept_id is exactly taxon_identity_hub_key. No name-derived ID is permitted.
taxon_work_key must equal taxon_identity_hub_key for every RC3 hub; divergence is FAIL.
ID_TAXON_JBLR and ID_TAXON_GOBIERNO are identifiers attached to a concept and are not substitutes for the concept identity key.
Empty or unknown external identifiers remain unknown; they are not zero, absence, or synthetic values.
L1_PACKET_01 does not mint identities outside the frozen RC3 universe.
An alias must resolve to exactly one existing taxon concept and cannot create, merge, or collapse concepts.
A name match alone cannot create an alias.
Historical aliases are retained; deletion is not permitted.
Supersession/replacement is an explicit directed relation between two distinct existing concept IDs.
Supersession/replacement requires provenance and a non-empty reason.
Supersession/replacement never deletes the historical source concept.
Cycles in supersession/replacement relations are invalid.
Every identification, external identifier, alias and supersession/replacement relation requires provenance.
Taxonomic names are separate records/assertions; NAME != IDENTITY.
Source records are evidence-bearing records; SOURCE_RECORD != TAXON_IDENTITY.
